text: [AA] A psalm of David. I Lord, who may abide in your tent? [1]Who may dwell on your holy mountain? [2]
II Whoever walks without blame, [AB]doing what is right,speaking truth from the heart;
Who does not slander with his tongue,does no harm to a friend,never defames a neighbor;
Who disdains the wicked,but honors those who fear the Lord;Who keeps an oath despite the cost,
lends no money at interest, [3]accepts no bribe against the innocent. [AC]III Whoever acts like thisshall never be shaken.
